description: Ultraluxe Designs: brand identity, logo and graphic design studio in Tashkent, Uzbekistan. Brand books, packaging, social media design and 3D for companies in Uzbekistan and abroad.
intro: Ultraluxe is a brand identity and graphic designer in Tashkent, working with companies in Uzbekistan and abroad since 2017.
services: Logos, brand books and complete identity systems: colour, type, patterns, stationery, packaging and merch.
Posters, print, presentations, banners and packaging that clearly belong to one brand.
Post and story systems, carousels, covers and YouTube thumbnails built to be produced every week.
Product renders and logo animation made in Blender.
Retouching, colour correction, upscaling and composites.
Interfaces for websites and apps, when the brand needs one.
about: Hello, I'm Iskandar. I'm a graphic designer who builds brands: logos, identity systems and the everyday graphics that keep a brand alive.

I've worked with clients in Uzbekistan, Russia, Austria, Germany, Switzerland, the UK, Canada, Thailand, Cyprus, Turkey and Chile, from a yarn store in Berlin to an investment company in the UK. Since 2023 I've also designed every Instagram graphic for Inter Nation English School.
facts: Branding, graphic and social media design
Uzbekistan, Russia, Austria, Germany, Switzerland, UK, Canada, Thailand, Cyprus, Turkey, Chile

featured.line: Identity for a tech automation company: a monogram, an acid-lime colour system and merch.
Mascot logo, checkered pattern and packaging for a pizza delivery service.
Every Instagram graphic since 2023: six volumes of posts plus YouTube thumbnails.
A complete brand book for an investment company in the UK and Uzbekistan.
A monochrome coffee brand, from logo rules to cups, caps and a delivery van.
Logo and identity for a Berlin yarn store: a yarn-ball mark, a striped pattern and tote bags.

process: We talk through your business, your audience and what the design has to achieve.
I present directions shown on real applications, so you can judge them in context.
We polish the chosen direction together until every detail works.
You get all source files and guidelines, ready for print, web and social.

cv.name: Iskandar Norkulov
bio: Graphic designer based in Tashkent, focused on brand identity and visual communication. I build brands from the logo up: identity systems, brand guidelines, packaging, print and the social media content that keeps a brand visible every day.

Since 2017 I have worked with startups, schools, banks and insurance companies in Uzbekistan and ten other countries. A background in UI/UX and product design helps my identities work as well on screen as they do in print. No brief yet? I'll help you shape one.

jobs.tags: Social media design, print design, motion design
points: Sole graphic designer for the company, working within the marketing team.
Create all social media visuals for Instagram, YouTube and Telegram, including the main and Samarkand branch accounts: posts, stories, animations and video covers.
Design POS materials, print collateral and outdoor advertising.
Work with the marketing team on campaigns and overall strategy, and keep the brand consistent across every channel.

jobs.tags: Branding, logo design, packaging, social media design, 3D
points: Logos, identity systems and brand guidelines for clients in 11 countries.
Clients include Gorinvestment, Mverse, Online Pizza, BMC Coffee, Visual Addiction and Lieblingsgarn.

jobs.tags: Branding, logo design, packaging, social media design, 3D, UI design, motion design
points: Created static and motion content for the social media of Euroasia Insurance, Agisept, ART Discoveries Group and Asia Alliance Bank.
Designed POS materials, logos and brand identities, as well as UI/UX for client projects.

jobs.tags: Product design, UX research, user flows, wireframing, prototyping, usability testing
points: Led every stage of design at the company, from research and user flows to wireframes, prototypes and final UI.

Designed products for startups: a CRM for the BSpace fintech app, an ERP system for private schools, Yubor (a money-transfer app for CIS citizens), the admin panel for MyWork (a job platform for construction workers) and the iConsult web app for video conferences and seminars.

jobs.role: Social Media Marketing Manager and Lead Designer
jobs.tags: Social media marketing, graphic design, motion design, ad targeting, photography
points: Ran marketing, advertising, content, photography and design for the company, and served as lead designer for all 13 branches.
Grew the audience across Instagram, Telegram, Facebook and YouTube from 10K to 30K+ followers in one year, while improving follower retention.

awards: Winning logo for the Economics with Finance module at Westminster International University in Tashkent.
